algorithm: Resolve finding path to a typed graph node; unresolved identity is not patchable.
Add the artifact that owns the model-written value and its validator receipt.
Traverse required predecessor edges needed to re-prove the invariant, but do not thaw immutable authority nodes.
Traverse forward effect/consumer edges until a stable boundary whose inputs remain hash-exact.
Add adjacent scene entry/exit nodes for continuity findings.
Return repair_nodes, revalidation_nodes, immutable_context_nodes and boundary_assertions separately.
If node count, depth or ambiguity exceeds materialized caps, classify UNBOUNDED and escalate to subtree/stage; never guess a smaller closure.

mapping_examples.finding: actor capability missing at event E
repair_scope: producer effect or E realization, whichever validator identifies
revalidation_scope: actor state through first stable successor
knowledge timeline from producer to E

repair_scope: transition or explicit travel event subtree
minimum dominator subtree containing both endpoints
revalidation_scope: scene closure and downstream required obligations

safety: Exact finding propagation is necessary but not sufficient. A retry may run only when this closure is exact and bounded.
